features.title: Scrobbling from every service
features.text: Yandex Music, Spotify and SoundCloud connect directly, with no browser tab open. YouTube Music, VK and other web players work through the VEIN extension.

features.title: Honest statistics
features.text: Hour-by-hour history, top artists, tracks and albums for any period, a listening calendar and your own Wrapped whenever you want it.

features.title: Levels and achievements
features.text: Earn XP for every track you play to 85%, keep a daily streak, climb the ranks and compete on the leaderboard.

features.title: Listen together
features.text: Follow friends, see what they play right now, compare tastes and open a room where everyone hears the same track.

steps.title: Create a profile
steps.text: Sign up with a username and password. No email or phone number needed.

steps.title: Connect your music
steps.text: Link Yandex Music, Spotify or SoundCloud, install the extension, or import your Last.fm history.

steps.title: Watch your stats grow
steps.text: Every play shows up in your profile within seconds.

faq.a: No. VEIN shows exactly what came from your player, with no ads and no sponsored picks.

faq.q: Do I need the browser extension?
faq.a: No. Yandex Music, Spotify and SoundCloud connect directly. The extension is for YouTube Music, VK and other web players.
The app itself is in Russian for now. Charts, numbers and track names read the same in any language.
You decide: make your profile public or private, and choose what your friends see in their feed.

faq.q: Can I take my data with me?
faq.a: Yes. Export your whole history from the settings, or delete your account together with its data.
